Bprime: All B trajectories and turns; preserve complete post-think suffix byte-for-byte

hygiene.H1: Every sweep has logical truncation rate <0.02 (physical cap OR missing think close); never hide failed candidate attempts
hygiene.H2: Strict post-think JSON for teachers/paraphraser, independently agreed VERDICT parser for Monitor5
hygiene.H3: Neutral operational names and all four outcomes preserved, including A violations/malformed rows
hygiene.H4: 100% prompts, raw completions, attempts and adapter bytes persist in the clean volume namespace
hygiene.H5: Zero pilot truncations; complete envelope/parser agreement; shared paired boilerplate masking audit inherited and rechecked
hygiene.pilots: Fresh raw trials for each teacher/corpus/cot, paraphraser, Monitor5 adapter, student/readout and floor; complete before its full durable call

matching.C_selection: Unique whole examples only; no repetitions or trimming
matching.gradient_contract: Accumulate every turn of each selected episode; normalize loss over supervised tokens in the episode batch
matching.solver_limit_status: UNKNOWN_LIMIT; never a proof of infeasibility
matching.supervised_token_count: Reported independently, not substituted for total training tokens
matching.token_count: Sum of every consumed turn prompt_token_ids plus complete target_token_ids including one EOS; no padding
